refine_summary: Phase 1 (MAX_ITERATIONS=2). Iteration 1 run failed: ModuleNotFoundError for qiskit.opflow.PauliSumOp. Fix 1: added compatibility import for PauliSumOp with graceful fallback and guarded all PauliSumOp usages to raise informative ImportError when unavailable. Iteration 2 run failed: ImportError for qiskit.primitives.Estimator. Fix 2: added compatibility import block for Estimator, trying qiskit.primitives then qiskit_aer.primitives; added early check to raise informative error if Estimator is unavailable. After second fix, next run (beyond MAX_ITERATIONS) shows a primitives interface mismatch: qiskit_algorithms.VQE expects Estimator V2 but Aer provides Estimator V1, causing TypeError (missing 'observables') wrapped as AlgorithmError. Final status: still failing after MAX_ITERATIONS. Recommended next steps (Phase 2/3): switch to BackendEstimator or EstimatorV2, or align qiskit_algorithms version with available primitives.
